name: Justin Holmes
tagline: CRYPTOGRASS · and the Immutable String Band · Ashland, Oregon
bio: Leader of Justin Holmes and the Immutable String Band — 'songs of a peaceful internet age, video game traditionals, and dirty old bluegrass' (their words). Namer of cryptograss: bluegrass and blockchains as one tradition of preserving and remixing music outside the IP system. Vowel Sounds (2023, Stargel Studios Nashville, with Cory Walker and Harry Clark) was revealed on-chain via Revealer on Threshold. Formerly building privacy tech at NuCypher; ETHDenver workshop & talk veteran. Releases CC BY-SA.
songs_note: Nothing hosted without the artist's word — his music lives at his own doors under CC BY-SA. This shelf waits for what Justin blesses into the orchestra.
